project: Conker's Bad Fur Day for PS Vita (CBFD-Recompiled)
approach: Static recompilation (based on CBFD-Recompiled), a native sceGxm renderer for the N64's display lists and the audio microcode run on the Vita's CPU
notes: Plays start to finish on a real Vita at the game's 30 fps cap, with optional interpolated 60 fps, 16:9, saves, remappable controls and touch, in-game updates, and every text in English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, French, German and Italian. Next: faster rendering on hardware and native rewrites of hot functions with the decomp's help.
